label: Rss
depicts: Rounded square tile holding one lower dot with two broadcast arcs rising inside the frame
use_when: Use when the interface wants the RSS mark contained inside a rounded square badge or app style tile.
avoid_when: Do not use for the loose RSS signal when the dot and arcs should appear without any outer frame.

label: Rss
depicts: One lower dot with two broadcast arcs floating freely without any outer square frame
use_when: Use when the interface wants a bare RSS signal with no container around the dot and arcs.
avoid_when: Do not use for the RSS tile when the same signal should sit inside a rounded square badge.

label: Sandglass
depicts: Angular hourglass with flat top and bottom caps and two straight triangular chambers touching at the waist
use_when: Use when the interface wants a geometric hourglass with crisp flat ends and a narrow center pinch.
avoid_when: Do not use for the softer hourglass variant when the sides should bow outward in a more rounded shape.

label: Sandglass
depicts: Hourglass with rounded outer sides that curve inward toward a pinched middle
use_when: Use when the interface wants an hourglass silhouette with softer bowed sides instead of a rigid angular frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straighter hourglass when the chambers should look more triangular with flatter end caps.

label: Save
depicts: Document page with one folded corner and a large check mark centered inside the page
use_when: Use when the interface wants save to feel like a confirmed document or completed file action.
avoid_when: Do not use for the floppy disk variant when the save concept should reference storage media instead of a checked page.
